about_the_game:
IndianOps is a free-to-play, tactical shooter that immerses players in high-stakes combat scenarios inspired by real-world military operations. Engage in intense multiplayer battles where strategy, teamwork, and quick reflexes are key to victory.

Key Features:

  • Tactical Gameplay: Utilize a variety of weapons and equipment to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Success depends on strategic planning and coordinated team efforts.

  • Diverse Environments: Experience combat across meticulously designed maps that challenge your tactical skills and adaptability.

  • Regular Updates: Stay engaged with frequent content updates, including new maps, weapons, and game modes, based on community feedback.

Prepare for action, strategize with your team, and dominate the battlefield in IndianOps.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
